lines.t: If you only pay the minimum on your credit card, this is what happens.
lines.title: THE MINIMUM *TRAP*

lines.t: Say you owe five thousand dollars at about twenty-two percent interest. That's close to the US average right now.
lines.title: $5,000 AT *22%*
lines.sub: near the current US average APR

lines.t: If you pay only the minimum, it takes about nineteen years to pay it off.
lines.label: Paying only the minimum
lines.title: TO BE *DEBT-FREE*

lines.t: And you pay over eight thousand dollars in interest. More than the original debt.
lines.label: Total interest paid
lines.title: IN *INTEREST*

lines.t: Pay two hundred a month instead, and you're done in under three years, with about eighteen hundred in interest.
lines.title: INTEREST *PAID*

lines.t: The minimum payment is designed to keep you paying. Follow to keep more of your money.
lines.title: PAY MORE THAN *THE MINIMUM*
